responsibility: Specs-table contribution for Objective-C++ driver dispatch: it maps `.mm` and `.M` inputs and the `@objective-c++`/`@objective-c++-header` spec names to `cc1objplus`, including preprocessing, PCH, and saved-temps handling, so the driver invokes the Objective-C++ compiler with the same command-line shaping as the C++ front end but for mixed ObjC++ sources.
